items.title: Dalton Richards Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: Now, at one time, I had a bass player playing with me, Jim Davis.

ctx.x: bum around all the rest of the night. Yeah, I couldn't do it.

So, I mean, after that group broke up, I lost inches. I played a couple of times with a Tiffany Cates fan, he needed a piano player, asked me could I come help him out. I told him, Sidney, well you know I'm not playing anymore. He said, well come on, you can sing, maybe, just come on out and help me. He had a ball to play, and he said he needed a piano player. I don't know what happened to his regular piano player, so I went out and I played a couple times with him. But his group was all nice bunch of friendly…
He's playing with Fat Domino now.
